registration: prospective local follow-up informed by prior three-seed results; not an external preregistration
scope: complete supported-loss-precision x epsilon x three-seed paired reconstruction; not a full paper reproduction

implementation_choices_not_specified_by_.input: two tokens [a,b], shared token embedding, learned two-position embedding, read last position
implementation_choices_not_specified_by_.attention: causal, manual scaled dot product, biases enabled, no dropout
implementation_choices_not_specified_by_.initialization: PyTorch defaults for embedding/linear; position normal std 0.02
implementation_choices_not_specified_by_.decay: all parameters, including biases and embeddings

pairing: standard and fixed arms copy identical initial weights and use the same split
primary_endpoints: target-gradient zero counts at both loss and float32 model interfaces at each logged training step
acceptance: exact 36-cell inventory, all 10000 epochs, every checkpoint, finite metrics and valid raw model tensors; no superiority threshold
analysis: all cells and seeds retained; paired descriptive differences; no p-value or universal superiority claim; no early stopping or extending after inspecting outcomes
precision_contract: model parameters and forward remain float32; only the logits entering CE are cast to the selected loss dtype; autograd casts loss derivatives back to model float32
initialization: reuse every original seed initial model and split; all cells paired; never start from a trained checkpoint
baseline_check: fp32 epsilon=1e-8 final state must equal its original parent state for every seed and arm
